overview_description.description:
Tessian’s mission is to secure the human layer. Using machine learning technology, Tessian automatically stops data breaches and security threats caused by human error - like data exfiltration, accidental data loss, business email compromise, and phishing attacks - with minimal disruption to employees' workflow. As a result, employees are empowered to do their best work, without security getting in their way. 

Founded in 2013, Tessian is backed by renowned investors like Sequoia, Accel, March Capital, and Balderton, and has offices in San Francisco and London.

product.name: Email Threat Defense
product.description: AI-based email security that detects and prevents advanced phishing attacks and email threats such as BEC, ATO, and impersonation.

product.name: Email Exfiltration Protection
product.description: AI-driven detection and prevention of unauthorized data exfiltration via email using behavioral and content analysis.

product.name: Email Misdelivery Protection
product.description: Machine learning-based detection and prevention of accidental or misdirected email data loss through recipient and content analysis.

product.name: Investigation and Response (I&R)
product.description: A platform for fast search, investigation, and automated remediation of email threats and incidents.

product.name: In-the-Moment Coaching
product.description: Contextual user warnings that educate employees on email risks to improve security decision-making in real time.
